name: AK Turnip 1.15 Rutabaga
description: AK Turnip 1.15 Rutabaga: AK Turnip 1.14 Rutabaga (native KGSL timeline synchronization) plus cached IO-coherent host memory by default (tu_override_uncached_as_cache_coherent, only where KGSL supports it), a fix for GPU-culled/indirect content disappearing since 1.10 (descriptor sets were not re-emitted after re-recording a command buffer), fixes for two other AK-only caches (dynamic-rendering GMEM layout cache key, GMEM clear register cache), upstream NIR CSE fix for texture instructions with different result types, and Adreno 753/735 IDs. Built with platform-sdk-version=33.
author: aydar
